name: Mr. Iori
source:
Father of Maya and Tenju.
He's old enough that it wouldn't be inappropriate to call him "grandpa", though he does have his own children.
He's apparently a very accomplished fellow.

It's hard to tell what thoughts lie behind his gentle smile.

[translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/az/wakaba_top.html]official website[/url]]
